listing.title: Bento Cake Box 500 ml
listing.body_text:
Pack of 25 Pieces

Pack, serve, and enjoy meals sustainably with the 500 ml Square Bento Box. Made from 100% natural, biodegradable, and compostable materials, this eco-friendly container is strong, sturdy and ideal for cakes and baked goods Its hinged clamshell design ensures easy handling, secure closure, and mess-free transport, making it perfect for takeaways, deliveries and on-the-go meals.

🏅 Certifications: This product is certified biodegradable and compostable. View our Certificates

SPECIFICATIONS

• Colour – White

• Odour – None

• Taste – None

• Shape – Square

• Length – 153 mm

• Width – 153 mm

• Height – 42 mm

• Internal Volume – 500 ml

PRODUCT FEATURES

• 100% Biodegradable

• 100% Compostable

• 100% Natural

• No binders, fillers, coating or liners

• Can be used for hot and cold foods

• Microwave safe up to +180 °C

• Freezer safe up to – 20 °C

• Water proof / Leak proof

Frequently Asked Questions

•
Is the Ecoware Bento Cake Box 500 ml compostable?
Yes, it is made from plant-based material and is 100% biodegradable and compostable.

•
Is it suitable for food delivery?
Yes. The container is designed for takeaway and food delivery applications.

•
Can it hold hot food?
Yes, it is suitable for serving and packing hot food, subject to the product’s stated temperature specifications.

•
Is it leakproof?
Yes, the container is designed to be waterproof and leak-resistant.

•
Is this product microwave-safe?
Yes, all the sugarcane bagasse products are microwave-proof.

•
How many pieces are in one pack?
Each pack contains 25 pieces.
